intro: Mizzou has strong tools — each in its own place. Tiger Guide helps you ask questions; this page is your quick link directory to every official app.

tools.name: Stellic
tools.description: Degree planning, course schedules, prerequisites, and graduation requirements.

tools.name: myZou
tools.description: Register for classes, view enrollment, student account, and official records.

tools.name: MizzouOne
tools.description: Student task hub — holds, required to-dos, and quick links to campus services.

tools.name: Academic Advising
tools.description: Find your advisor, scheduling help, and college-specific advising resources.

tools.name: Registrar
tools.description: Enrollment appointments, academic calendar, and registration policies.

tools.name: Handshake
tools.description: Jobs, internships, career fairs, and employer events for Mizzou students.

tools.name: MU Career Center
tools.description: Resume help, interview prep, and career advising resources.

tools.name: Mizzou Mentoring
tools.description: Browse alumni mentors and request conversations in your field.

tools.name: Big Interview
tools.description: Mock interview practice through the Career Center.

tools.name: Official campus map
tools.description: Mizzou's official interactive map — buildings, parking, accessibility.

tools.name: Off-campus housing

tools.name: MU Engage

tools.name: Campus dining
